segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Hi, this is Megan from Northstar Clinics. I’m calling about ticket 482713, the user import for our West Region team.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Yeah, hi Megan. Let me pull that up in the ticketing system. Okay, I see the import file for 84 users was received on July 29.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Right. I’m just checking where it stands because we hadn’t heard anything since Marcus uploaded the corrected CSV.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Understood. I’m looking at the notes now. The import passed validation this morning at 9:18 Eastern, and it’s currently queued to run in the admin console batch window tonight.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Okay, so no action needed from our side?

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Correct. The email field and department codes all look good. The only thing flagged was three duplicate inactive accounts, and our team already mapped those to the existing profiles.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Got it. We have managers expecting access tomorrow. Is that still realistic?

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Yes. The batch should complete by 11:00 p.m. Eastern, and the accounts should be available before business hours tomorrow, July 31. I’ll add you and Marcus to the ticket update.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Perfect, thanks. That’s all I needed.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: No problem. I’ll leave the ticket open until the completion note posts in the morning.
